title: Elementary reasoning set 1
description: Synthetic practice items for testing a simulated learner; not a standardized IQ test.

questions.prompt: What is 54 - 18?

questions.prompt: What is 7 × 6?

questions.prompt: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2: 2/4, 2/3, or 3/4?

questions.prompt: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its perimeter in centimetres?

questions.prompt: Mina put on her boots because it was raining. Why did Mina put on her boots?

questions.subject: language
questions.prompt: In the sentence 'The bright bird sang,' which word describes the bird?
